parts.text: which digest is bigger, hn or tc?

args.code:
a = effect('http.get', {'url': 'https://example.test/hn-digest'})
b = effect('http.get', {'url': 'https://example.test/tc-digest'})
sizes = {'hn': len(a['body']), 'tc': len(b['body'])}
print('sizes', sizes)
max(sizes, key=sizes.get)

parts.text: The HN digest is the bigger one.
